sql: SELECT p.ProductKey, p.ProductName, sum(i.OnHandQuantity) AS OnHand, sum(i.SafetyStockQuantity) AS SafetyStock FROM retail.FactInventory AS i INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON p.ProductKey = i.ProductKey WHERE i.DateKey = (SELECT max(DateKey) FROM retail.FactInventory) GROUP BY p.ProductKey, p.ProductName HAVING OnHand < SafetyStock ORDER BY (SafetyStock - OnHand) DESC
